reasoning: On the season so far the Grizzlies are the stronger team; with home court the Grizzlies start about 9 points better, in a game of about 234 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Clippers.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Grizzlies (look-ahead, confidence).
Bottom line: the Grizzlies win 77 times in 100, by about 10; most games like this end between 206 and 254 total points.
